final_message:
No handle exposed a reachable capability to locate or read a license fragment. The repo handle's only reachable call was `status` (clean, master branch) with no further frontier calls after that, and the tests/git/episodes handles reported the requested capability unavailable in the reachable world.

I could not find an embedded ink license fragment anywhere in the reachable state — no readable file content, license text, or search/read capability was exposed by any of the four handles. Therefore I cannot state its permitted use; the fragment is not accessible through the currently reachable tool surface.
